highlights: no chain - open to all buyers / investors alike
close to local amenities, town and hospital
summary: Situated in the heart of the ever sought-after Denes area of town, this well-positioned property benefits from excellent access to a wide range of local amenities, reputable schools, the town centre, and the local hospital, making it a highly convenient and desirable location.
description:
An ideal opportunity for investors, the property is currently tenanted and therefore offers a ready-made investment with immediate rental income from day one. The strong rental demand within the area further enhances its appeal as a smart addition to any property portfolio. The accommodation is well laid out and briefly comprises an entrance leading into a comfortable lounge, a separate dining room providing additional living space, and a fitted kitchen to the rear. To the first floor are two well-proportioned bedrooms along with a family bathroom. Externally, the property benefits from a low-maintenance rear yard, typical of properties within this location. Offered with no onward chain, this is a straightforward purchase with viewings available immediately. Early inspection is recommended to fully appreciate both the location and the investment potential on offer.

ENTRANCE LOBBY Accessed via a wooden front door, the entrance lobby offers a welcoming introduction to the home and leads through to the lounge.

LOUNGE The lounge is a bright and inviting reception space, benefiting from a UPVC-framed double glazed window which allows for plenty of natural light. The room features laminate flooring, a stylish fire surround with inset as a focal point, and a radiator for comfort.

DINING ROOM The dining room is a bright and welcoming space, featuring a UPVC-framed double glazed window and a radiator. It flows seamlessly into the kitchen, creating a convenient open-plan layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.

KITCHEN / BREAKFAST ROOM The kitchen is appointed with a fitted range of base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and tiling to splashbacks and work areas. It features an inset sink unit, integrated oven, hob, and overhead extractor, as well as plumbing for an automatic washing machine. A UPVC-framed double glazed window allows natural light to fill the space, making it both practical and inviting.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

The landing provides access to both bedrooms and the bathroom, serving as a central and practical hub to the upper floor.

BEDROOM ONE The bedroom is a bright and comfortable space, featuring a UPVC-framed double glazed window that fills the room with natural light, and a radiator for added warmth.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom two is a light and airy room, featuring a UPVC-framed double glazed window and a radiator, providing a comfortable and versatile space.

FAMILY BATHROOM The bathroom features a fitted white suite, comprising a panelled bath, corner shower cubicle with inset shower, wash hand basin, and WC. The room is finished with tiling to splashback and vanity areas, a radiator for warmth, and a UPVC-framed double glazed window, creating a bright and functional space.

EXTERNALLY To the rear, there is an enclosed courtyard, offering a private outdoor space with gated access for added security and convenience.
